artworks.title: Charles L. Freer (?)
artworks.medium: charcoal touched with gray-green chalk on green laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch features a man shown from the chest up, facing forward with a slightly tilted head. Softly-rendered facial features hint at a moustache and a calm expression. His short hair is subtly outlined. He appears to be wearing a collared shirt or coat with indistinct details. The background is textured with crosshatched shading, creating a focus on the face while the rest of the paper is bare, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: The Battery, New York
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial perspective of a cityscape. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with hints of water in the background. Buildings are sketched in delicate pencil strokes, with smoke rising from chimneys. The scene becomes more abstract further away, with fading lines creating an ethereal quality. The monochromatic palette is dominated by soft grays. The style is loose and impressionistic, focusing on capturing the essence of the scene.

artworks.title: Manhattan Bridge
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated viewpoint overlooking a cityscape with a bridge in the distance. The horizon is low, with the bridge acting as a horizontal element. The pencil strokes are delicate and sketch-like, creating an ethereal quality. The color palette is monochromatic with soft gray tones. A tall structure is visible on the right, and the drawing includes rooftops and city structures blending into the hazy background.

artworks.title: North on Broadway from Trinity Church
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a city street, seen from above. The scene includes tall buildings lining the street, with a slanted structure on the left side. The horizon is implied by the diminishing height of the buildings. The sketch features delicate brushstrokes, creating depth and texture with fine lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of grey and black. The scene conveys a quiet urban landscape, with detailed building facades and a softer skyline in the distance.

artworks.title: Miami and Ohio Rivers
artworks.description: The image is a bird's eye view landscape sketch. The horizon is high on the page, lined with distant hills. Below the horizon is a plain with rows of trees and fields. The sketch uses soft pencil strokes to create depth and detail in the trees and vegetation. The color palette is monochrome in shades of graphite on warm paper. Terrain closest to the viewer suggests hills and valleys leading towards the horizon.

artworks.title: The Village Street
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural village scene with houses, a church spire, a road running alongside a stream, and people engaging in various activities. Additionally, there is a boat near the water. The painting features precise brushstrokes and uses a color palette of sepia tones, browns, and grays. The sky is clear with a few birds in the distance.

artworks.title: Moonlit Landscape with Tree at the Right
artworks.medium: monotype in black and gray ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a vertically oriented tree on the right side with its thick foliage and trunk depicted in energetic brushstrokes. On the left, the sky and land blend together in sweeping strokes, creating a sense of motion. The horizon is located towards the bottom third of the frame but is obscured by the merging of land and sky. The style is impressionistic, emphasizing texture and movement over precise detail. The color palette is monochromatic, using blacks and grays for depth and contrast, creating a striking visual impact that accentuates the scene's dynamism.

artworks.title: Moonlit Landscape with Tree at the Left
artworks.medium: monotype in black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from a slightly low point of view. The horizon is low, with bushy silhouettes and a gentle hill stretching across, beyond which rises a starless sky. A large tree occupies the left side of the scene, its trunk and branches rendered with thick brushstrokes. The moon is slightly off-center towards the upper right, casting a muted glow. The brushwork in the sky is fluid, with sweeping strokes. The color palette is monochrome with varying shades of black, grey, and white.

artworks.title: Endymion
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a seated figure looking at a globe. The central figure appears muscular and relaxed, with a contemplative expression. The scene is detailed with fine lines and shading. The figure's hand supports their chin as they gaze at the globe. The attire drapes around the figure in a classical style. Below the figure, there is a pedestal with text.

artworks.title: François Boucher
artworks.artist: Manuel Salvador Carmona, after Alexandre Roslin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man facing the viewer with his body slightly turned. The man has mature features, including a prominent nose, cheekbones, and deep-set eyes. His hair is styled in 18th-century fashion, with curls and possibly tied with a ribbon. He wears a decorated garment with lace details at the neckline and cuffs. He holds a brush and an artist's palette with brushes in the foreground. The background includes a textured circular frame.

artworks.title: Nicolas Coustou
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man seated, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a serious expression, prominent cheeks, and engaging eyes. He has long, curly hair falling around his shoulders. He is dressed in a detailed, formal garment with a high collar and visible buttons. He is holding a sculpting tool and leaning on an unfinished bust sculpture of a head. The background shows a simple shaded backdrop with a darkened wall or canvas. The composition emphasizes the man's craft and attire in a classic and formal artistic style.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Greuze
artworks.description: The image displays a side profile portrait of a man, focusing on his head and neck. The man is facing right with distinctive features such as a notable nose and high cheekbones. His eyes are directed forward. The man's hair is styled in an 18th-century fashion, with curls framing the sides of his head. The portrait excludes clothing, jewelry, or objects, with a textured oval frame in the background. Below the portrait, there is a plaque with the text "JEAN BTE GREUZE PEINTRE DU ROY." Additional inscriptions are visible at the bottom, enhancing the formal presentation of the image.

artworks.title: Nicolas Delaunay
artworks.artist: François Huot after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man in profile, facing left. The subject is in an oval frame, showing his head and torso. He has a Roman nose and a pronounced jawline, with curls of hair styled neatly and gathered at the back with a ribbon. He is dressed in a formal suit with a lace cravat and decorative buttons. The background has detailed cross-hatching for depth. The portrait has an ornate border with a ribbon at the top and French script below.

artworks.title: Christophe Gabriel Allegrain
artworks.artist: Ignaz Sebastian Klauber after Joseph Siffred Duplessis
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man facing slightly to the left. He has curly, shoulder-length hair and a distinguished nose. The man wears formal attire with a buttoned coat and holds a sculpting tool in his right hand. Beside him, the bare legs of a statue on a pedestal are visible. The background is dark, with an ornate border featuring captions identifying him as Christophe Gabriel Allegrain, a sculptor and academician.

artworks.title: Anne Vallayer-Coster
artworks.artist: Charles Francois Le Tellier after Anne Vallayer-Coster
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait in profile of a person facing right. The individual is positioned sideways, with the head turned slightly towards the viewer's side. The person has tall, voluminous coiffures adorned with what appears to be ribbons or decorative elements within the hair. The face shows classical features with a calm and serene expression. The attire is elaborate, with decorative lace or elaborate fabric around the neckline and shoulders. Surrounding the portrait is an ornate circular frame decorated with leafy motifs, possibly laurel leaves. Below the portrait, there is a decorative panel with scripted text, an artist’s palette, and brushes. The background of the image is filled with fine, detailed crosshatching.

artworks.title: Hubert Gravelot
artworks.artist: Jean Massard after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body in profile, focusing on his face and shoulders. The man has curly short hair and detailed facial features, including prominent eyes, a slightly hooked nose, and a firm mouth. He wears a coat with a high collar and a shirt with ruffles. The portrait is enclosed by a circular ornate border with a decorative ribbon or bow at the top. The background has a textured, cross-hatched pattern, and the name "Hubert Gravelot" is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Jean Restout
artworks.artist: Pierre Etienne Moitte after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man seated with a drawing tool in his right hand, resting on a large sheet of paper on his lap. The man has distinguished facial features and is looking slightly to his right. He has curls in his hair and is wearing an elaborate 18th-century outfit with a long coat and a cravat. He sits in an upholstered chair with a scroll design on top, and behind him is an easel with a blank canvas. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Nicolas Poussin
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust-length portrait. He is facing slightly left with a gaze towards the viewer. The man has well-defined facial features, a prominent nose, and lips set in a neutral expression. He has long, wavy hair, and is wearing a draped garment with intricate shading. He holds a scroll tied with a ribbon in his right hand. In the background, there are stacked picture frames, with an image of a classical figure wearing a crown visible in one frame. The background is intricately engraved with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Simeon Chardin
artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a man's head and shoulders framed within an oval medallion. The man is positioned in profile, facing to the right, with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and brow. The man's hair is styled in curls cascading down from his face, typical of 18th-century wigs. He wears a jacket with a leaf or flower pattern. The medallion is topped with a decorative ribbon or bow. The portrait is set against a textured background within the oval frame, which rests on a rectangular base with text detailing the name and titles of the artist Jean-Siméon Chardin. The creator information at the bottom of the image indicates it was drawn in 1776.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Descamps
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a side profile of his head and upper shoulders, within a rounded frame. The man has a prominent nose, a slightly pointed chin, and tied back hair. He wears formal period clothing, and the background is textured. The circular frame has a decorative bow on top, and the bottom displays engraved text with the name "Jean-Baptiste Descamps" and additional information about him.

artworks.title: Jean Jouvenet
artworks.description: The image shows an upper half portrait of a man seated in an ornately carved chair. He is turned slightly to his right, holding a painter's palette and brushes in his left hand while his right hand is raised with one finger pointing upward. He wears attire from the late 17th to early 18th century, including a voluminous robe with wide sleeves and lace cuffs at the wrists. His facial features include a high forehead and pronounced nose, with a composed expression. His hair is curly and styled in the fashion of the time, falling past his shoulders. In the background, there is a draped curtain in a dimly lit interior. The portrait is set within an oval frame, with a pedestal below bearing the inscription "JEAN JOUVENET Peintre Ordinaire du Roy Directeur de l’Academie Royale 1707."

artworks.title: San Gimignano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Sam R. Broadbent
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape with ancient stone towers and buildings rising against the sky. The horizon is near the top of the image. The towers are intricately detailed, showcasing historical architecture. Vegetation with swirling lines is shown in the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black to convey timelessness and solemnity, with stark contrasts between light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Hat Pin (Le chapeau epingle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Sam R. Broadbent
artworks.description: The image displays a partial view of two women's upper bodies, mainly focusing on their heads and shoulders. One woman is seated with her head slightly turned to the side, and the other woman is standing or leaning toward her, their heads close together. The woman on the left has long hair, while the woman on the right has her face partially obscured. Both women are wearing large brimmed hats with floral decorations. The seated woman appears to be adjusting the brim of her hat with one hand. The artwork is an etching with delicate swirling line work defining the figures and their surroundings. The background features expressive swirling lines, adding movement and depth to the composition, with no distinct objects visible beyond the figures.

artworks.title: The Four Horsemen
artworks.creditLine: Ferdinand Lammot Belin Fund and William Nelson Cromwell Fund
